senses.gloss: (b. h.) to open the mouth; to blow; to cry.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 11b:13">Sot. 11ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Q00298"><he>פועה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Exodus 1:15">Ex. I, 15</cite>) <he>שהיתה פּוֹעָה ומוציאה את הוולד</he> (Ar. <he>פ׳ לוולד</he>) she blew (a charm into the mother’s ear) and brought the child forth; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:1:3">Koh. R. to VII, 1</cite> <he>שהיתה פועה באשה וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:1:3">ib.</cite> <he>שהיתה פועה ובוכה על וכ׳</he> she cried out and wept for her brother &c.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:1:3">Ib.</cite> <he>שפָּעַת בפני פרעה וכ׳</he> she cried out before Pharaoh, saying &c. Sot. l. c. <he>שהיתה פועה ברוח וכ׳</he> she cried in holy inspiration and said, my mother is destined to bear a son who will save Israel.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27">Lev. R. s. 27</cite>; Tanḥ. Emor 11, v. <cite ref="Q01380"><he>פְּעִיָּיה</he></cite>. Midr. Sam. ch. XXII <he>פָּעֲתָה כעגלה</he> she lowed like a heifer; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 38:2">Yalk. ib. 38</cite> <he>הוא מַפְעֶה אחריך</he> it (the stolen lamb) is bleating behind thee.
